records.name: Tori
records.tagline: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences
records.description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

records.name: shippedit.me
records.tagline: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights
records.description: Weekly launch battles + a permanent page that keeps working: dofollow backlink, AEO & CRO audits, competitor monitoring, real analytics, and AI fix cards.

records.name: SimpleSpread
records.tagline: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet
records.description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

records.name: HireKey
records.tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
records.description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

records.name: kōdlo
records.tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
records.description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

records.name: DevTerminal
records.tagline: A macOS terminal with a Run button that knows your project
records.description: DevTerminal is a normal macOS terminal (your shell, your config) where every tab knows what project it's in. ⌘R in an Android app installs it on your phone and streams logcat. In an iOS app it launches in the Simulator or on your iPhone. Spring Boot, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, Rust, Go, Django, Rails and more just work. Run output sits under your shell, so Claude Code keeps the tab. $39 once, no subscription.

records.name: Pickle Sensei
records.tagline: AI pickleball coach for solo training, one swing at a time
records.description: Pickle Sensei is an AI pickleball coach for solo training on iPhone. Step into the start zone alone, swing one stroke, and get an estimated player rating, a technique score, checkpoint scores, and the one thing to fix next. Covers serves, returns, drives, dinks, third-shot drops, volleys and overheads. Slow-motion form review with a skeleton overlay, 40+ drills, progress tracking and ranks. Video stays on your device. Free to try, one rating included, then Pro from $7.99 a month.

records.name: Ayven
records.tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
records.description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

records.name: NewMinecraftServers
records.tagline: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection.
records.description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.

records.name: OpenScreen 2
records.tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
records.description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

records.name: MePersona
records.tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
records.description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

records.name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
records.tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
records.description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.

records.name: NotchPit
records.tagline: Your Mac's notch, rearranged into a control center
records.description: NotchPit turns the space around your Mac's camera into a control center: music with synced lyrics, prayer times with adhan, your next meeting, and 64 extensions from uptime checks to revenue. Drag, resize and swipe them into your own layout. Try it free for 14 days, then buy once and keep it for life.

records.name: Farol
records.tagline: The macOS terminal that shows which coding agent needs you
records.description: Farol is a macOS terminal for running Claude Code and Codex in parallel. A sidebar shows which agent is working, which is waiting for you and which is done, and the menu bar shows it from any app. Each task gets its own git worktree, started from a prompt, a GitHub issue or a Jira ticket. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in the same window. Built on libghostty, so it reads your Ghostty config. Free and MIT licensed. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: Kooler
records.tagline: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar
records.description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

records.name: Agibot
records.tagline: The always-on personal AI agent for your Mac. $0 forever
records.description: Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

records.name: Unboom
records.tagline: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels
records.description: Unboom finds the bass note your untreated room exaggerates and gently turns just that down on your Mac. Scan with your mic or pick it by ear, choose Gentle, Medium, or Strong, and flip Correction on. Never boosts. No data collected. No subscription.

records.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
records.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
records.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

records.name: Foley
records.tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
records.description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

records.name: Ghost Core
records.tagline: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device
records.description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

records.name: FocusWrite
records.tagline: A local-first writing app with focus modes.
records.description: A calm, local-first writing app with deep focus, ambient sounds, optional cloud sync, and PDF export.

records.name: Poke Finder
records.tagline: Catch Pokémon while you browse and complete your Pokédex.
records.description: Catch Pokémon while browsing. Discover Generations 1-9, Shiny Pokémon, Mega Evolution and companions with Poke Finder.

records.name: FloorGen
records.tagline: Draw the house, or just ask. Free floor plans with AI
records.description: Plan a remodel, an ADU or a whole house for free in your browser. Describe it and FloorGen AI builds it, every change an undo step. Then check it against the IRC, walk through it in 3D and print the plan set. Claude and ChatGPT can edit it too.

records.name: KarmaBoard
records.tagline: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV
records.description: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV. Display your own custom text, plus live feeds like weather, sports scores, stock prices and transit schedules... and watch every letter clack into place.

records.name: Edgee Mod for Claude Code
records.tagline: Use any model inside Claude Code, keep your Claude plan
records.description: A Claude Code mod that puts Edgee in your terminal. Keep your Claude plan, switch your session to any of 200+ models in one keystroke, and see live what compression and routing save you. Same conversation, same context. Two commands to install.

records.name: Halo
records.tagline: Notifications, dictation and AI agents in your Mac's notch
records.description: Halo turns your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island: messages from any app, dictation that types anywhere when you hold Fn, a little face that follows your cursor and watches your AI agents, plus music, calls and monitor brightness. $9.99 once.

records.name: EdgeVolume
records.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume from your trackpad edge
records.description: Slide one finger along your Mac’s trackpad edge to adjust the volume. Choose the left edge, right edge, or both, and tune the sensitivity to your preference. EdgeVolume is a free, open-source macOS utility that runs in your menu bar. Currently in early access.

records.name: ASL rBroker
records.tagline: Coordinate approved GPU and CPU work across your computers
records.description: Coordinate GPU leases, bounded CPU workers and optional resource reporting across computers you control. GPU admission requires supported NVIDIA hardware. Fleet work uses a trusted HTTPS coordinator, registered handlers and explicit permissions. CPU and GPU memory remain separate; rBroker does not pool VRAM or provide arbitrary remote commands. Paid Microsoft Store app; hosting and third-party service costs are separate.

records.name: Complisight
records.tagline: PPE and safety compliance from existing CCTV
records.description: CompliSight supports industrial safety supervision with CCTV-based exception detection, review workflows and evidence records.

records.name: OrgNexuz
records.tagline: The Organization Operating System
records.description: *OrgNexuz™ — The Organization Operating System* One platform to run your entire organization. OrgNexuz unifies Org Management, People, HR, Workflows, CRM, Community, Documents, Digital ID, Training & Certification, and AI Intelligence. Manage branches, staff, payroll, approvals, customers, events, certificates & KPIs — all in one place. http://www.orgnexuz.com

records.name: Pikabox
records.tagline: Store, share and play your own files and videos
records.description: Pikabox brings cloud file storage, sharing and video playback together on Android and iOS. Upload documents, photos and videos, download selected files for offline access, and create personal or public channels to share your own content.

records.name: URLClinic
records.tagline: Inspect links trace redirects spot URL risks
records.description: Understand where a link leads before you click or share it. URLClinic traces redirects, highlights potential threats and download risks, and helps you find moved pages. Create Rescue Links, share previews, and QR codes—all in one place. Built for website owners, developers, and anyone who wants more context about a URL.

records.name: Nox Hall
records.tagline: Your browser game hall. Poker now, more games to come.
records.description: Nox Hall is a free browser game platform, starting with No-Limit Texas Hold’em. Play against labelled bots, join Quick Play, or invite friends to a private room. Start as a guest, learn the rules in the lobby, and keep your progress when you register. Chips are virtual and can’t be bought or cashed out. More games, including chip-free play, are in development and under wraps.

records.name: Loan EMI Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate EMI, interest, and loan payoff
records.description: Estimate monthly loan payments, total interest, and an initial amortization schedule. Adjust principal, interest rate, and tenure to understand borrowing costs before committing.

records.name: Pizazoo for iPhone and iPad
records.tagline: Find any screenshot on your iPhone by the words inside it
records.description: Pizazoo started as a screenshot organizer for Mac. Now it is on iPhone and iPad. It reads the text in every screenshot and files each one into categories like Receipts, Chats, Code and Travel, all on your device. Search a word you remember and the right screenshot comes back. Save images from the share sheet in any app, sort a new screenshot from its notification, and blur anything private before you share. Free, with an optional one-time Pro.

records.name: Phosphor
records.tagline: Spaced repetition app with FSRS: cards from lectures
records.description: Phosphor is a spaced repetition app for people who study from lectures. Paste a YouTube link, type a topic, or paste notes you already have. It writes a summary and notes, then builds flashcards from them, and each video card links to the second it came from. Cards are scheduled with FSRS, so each one comes back on the day it starts to fade. Export any deck to Anki. Free to start; Pro lifts the limits.

records.name: Advance Data Analytics Course
records.tagline: Best institute For Data Analytics & Digital Marketing Course
records.description: Brillica Services offers professional courses in Digital Marketing and Data Analytics to help students and working professionals develop industry-relevant skills. Learn SEO, social media marketing, Google Ads, Excel, SQL, Python, and Power BI through practical training and hands-on projects. Enhance your expertise, gain valuable knowledge, and prepare for exciting career opportunities in the digital and data-driven industries. 🌐 Website: https://www.brillicaservices.com/

records.name: SendVeil
records.tagline: Secure file transfer with EU storage and private links
records.description: SendVeil is a secure file transfer service with private EU storage, original downloads and private links. Recipients need no account. Send up to 5 GB free with 7-day expiry, or choose a EUR 6.90 one-off transfer. Pro, Business and Agency plans add capacity, branded download pages, custom domains, teams and file requests. Resumable uploads support single files up to 450 GB on eligible plans. Passwords, expiry and 20 interface languages help freelancers, studios and teams share files with clients.

records.name: EasyToSTL
records.tagline: Turn images into watertight STL models for 3D printing
records.description: Convert image to STL with AI. Free image to STL converter for 3D printing. Turn PNG & JPG into watertight STL models for Bambu Studio or Cura. Free credits.

records.name: Konektr
records.tagline: Marketing and commerce reports for your AI workspace
records.description: Konektr brings supported marketing and commerce accounts into business workspaces. Explore reports in the portal or through MCP in Claude and ChatGPT, stage media, and preview supported actions before approval. Account permissions and platform approvals determine available features.

records.name: Math Royale- Online Competition Game
records.tagline: Daily leaderboard and MBR Rewards are granted to users
records.description: 24hr Daily Cycle leaderboardmeans daily you have to compete with players and climb up the rank to gain the maximum MBR prize from the prize pool. The prize pool increase by 10 mbr per player. So more players drives high prize pool and a dynamic formula to distribute the rewards. Also we have the practice screen where you can do practjce custom and your time and games played are stored online securely

records.name: CareerNest
records.tagline: AI powered resume checker and builder.
records.description: Go from resume to hire: tailor to job descriptions, check ATS scores, and ace HR interviews with CareerNest's AI toolkit.

records.name: RunMyPharmacy
records.tagline: POS, inventory and expiry tracking for Pakistani pharmacies
records.description: RunMyPharmacy brings barcode billing, medicine inventory, batch and expiry tracking, purchasing and reports into one workflow for pharmacies and medical stores in Pakistan. It supports English and Urdu, with PKR-focused operations. Free during early access. Our practical guides also help owners plan startup budgets, suppliers and opening stock.

records.name: RizCare
records.tagline: Patient records and practice management for Nigerian clinics
records.description: RizCare brings patient records, appointments, clinical notes, lab results and billing into one workspace for Nigerian care teams. Supported workflows stay available on enrolled devices during outages, then sync when connectivity returns.

records.name: Revival Guide — Bug Report Builder
records.tagline: Turn game issues into an editable support report, locally
records.description: A free, independent tool for Hellraiser: Revival players. Record your platform, expected and actual behavior, and reproduction steps. Edit, copy or download a plain-text report, then send it yourself to official support. No login, uploads or automatic submission. Not affiliated with Saber. Built with AI assistance; no claim of hands-on game testing.

records.name: Altair Play
records.tagline: Every game you own, every hour you’ve played, in one place
records.description: Download the Altair Play Game Launcher and Tracker for PC. Track your playtime, organize your library and launch games from one place.

records.name: Search Engine Indexer (Lifetime Deal)
records.tagline: Fast AI Google & Bing indexing for a $29 lifetime deal
records.description: Stop paying monthly subscriptions or buying credit packs just to index URLs. Search Engine Indexer uses smart AI automation and official Google Indexing API & IndexNow to submit and rank your pages rapidly. Track real-time indexing status and Search Console verdicts in one unified dashboard. Get lifetime access for a one-time launch price: Business $29, Agency $99. Built by DependsiT.

records.name: My Handler
records.tagline: Screen capture. Dictation. Files. Meetings. Phone it. Local.
records.description: MyHandler is a local-first AI assistant that knows your entire digital life and even let's you phone and text it for assistance! It's for people who don't want their email, meetings, files and calls stored on someone else's server. All your data stays on your machine, and uses a locally hosted model. Cloud AI is opt-in. Meeting transcripts run via local Whisper.

records.name: Metis
records.tagline: Every word you look up becomes a card you'll remember
records.description: Metis is for people who already speak a second language or are learning one but keep forgetting the words they look up: idioms, slang, phrasal verbs, the expressions natives use. Search a word or phrase in either language and Metis builds a card with the translation, meaning and a real example. Spaced repetition brings it back at 1, 2, 4 and 7 days, in four review styles, until you know it. You can also share them with your friends. iPhone widget, 21 interface languages, free plan.

records.name: Dumb Ways to Ship
records.tagline: Break 19 vibe-coded apps and earn fake bug bounties
records.description: An interactive museum of vibe-coded software. 19 tiny apps that "work perfectly", each hiding one catastrophic bug: an AI chatbot leaking its API key, a checkout that trusts your price, admin via ?isAdmin=true, SQL injection, XSS, race conditions and more. Exploit them right in your browser, earn fake bug bounties (critical = $10k), unlock ranks, and buy hints if you're stuck. Every exhibit explains what went wrong and how to fix it for real. Nothing real gets hurt.

records.name: LORAX
records.tagline: AI girlfriend app where the characters have their own day
records.description: LORAX is an AI girlfriend and AI boyfriend app for iPhone, built like a messaging app. More than 500 characters live on their own clock: they work, sleep and change moods. They text you first, remember what you told them weeks ago, talk to each other in group chats and go live with a crowd in the room. You can also create your own character. Free to download and talk in, with optional credits and Premium. 24 languages. Everyone in the app is fictional.

records.name: Ranflo
records.tagline: Workspace built for your service business, not enterprises.
records.description: Ranflo brings leads, clients, jobs, income/expense tracking, and business record-keeping into one connected workspace for freelancers and service businesses. Capture leads through a form, move them through a pipeline, convert to a job, and track it start to finish. Clients get their own portal to check status, message you, and leave reviews, no account needed, just a link. Free to start, built solo.

records.name: ZMS AI
records.tagline: Create AI Images and Videos with Powerful AI Models
records.description: ZMS AI is an AI-powered creative platform for generating and editing images and videos online. Turn text prompts and reference images into visual content using a range of AI models. Key features include: - AI image generation from text prompts - AI video creation with text and image references - AI image editing and outfit changes - AI video extension for longer creative sequences - Multiple AI models in one creative workspace Ideal for content creators, designers, and marketers..

records.name: YATFA
records.tagline: Platform built for agentic-first developers
records.description: YATFA builds the engineering organization your agents have been missing. Instead of another chat UI, a deterministic engine orchestrates the entire lifecycle against your codebase 24/7. We give agents the exact environment, toolchains, and repository context they need to ship: planning, implementation, multi-stage review, and background code improvements. Stop managing agents, run an autonomous engineering team that ships.

records.name: Athuga Affiliate Analytics
records.tagline: Advanced affiliate analytics made simple for WordPress
records.description: Meet Athuga Affiliate Analytics — a free WordPress plugin that helps you understand how your affiliate links perform. Track clicks, unique visitors, top-performing pages, traffic sources, countries, devices, and browsers directly from your WordPress dashboard. No need for external analytics platforms. Start with the free version and upgrade to Pro when you need deeper insights, revenue analytics, conversion tracking, and scheduled reports. Track. Understand. Discover.

records.name: Hormone-Smart Rhythm
records.tagline: Cycle-aligned fasting for women, worked out for you
records.description: Most fasting plans ignore women’s monthly hormonal shifts. Pushing long fasts right before your bleed spikes cortisol and crashes energy. The hormone-smart rhythm creates a personalized 30-day fasting calendar mapped to your exact cycle day: • Daily fasting hours converted into real dates • Gentle nurture days when your body needs carbs • Guidance for regular, irregular, and menopausal cycles • Safe tracks for thyroid, fatigue & autoimmune Try the free assessment—no information required.

records.name: Aki
records.tagline: Point at your screen, your coding agent fixes it
records.description: Aki is a free Mac app for people who code with AI agents. Press ⇧⌘A, point at anything on screen (an element in Chrome, an area, a terminal error, a file in Finder), write what should change and press ⌘⏎. Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent gets the exact element and your note in the right session: a localhost page goes to the worktree serving that port. Made for running many agents at once. Text first, a crop only when it helps. Local, no account.

records.name: Momo-Office Desktop Companion
records.tagline: Your AI office companion, right on your desktop
records.description: Momo is a voice-driven AI desktop companion that simplifies everyday office work, from drafting emails and managing meeting follow-ups to instantly finding and opening relevant files from your desktop or SharePoint with a single command. She can also remind you of important points to discuss with specific people when they join your meeting, helping you stay prepared, organized, and focused.

records.name: Workout Diary - Timer & Logs
records.tagline: Track workout time, routines and weight in one place
records.description: Keep your training history together on Android. Time workouts and rest, log sets, reps and weights, and review routines in a calendar. Follow workout time, frequency and body-weight changes with charts. Includes reminders, shareable workout images, and email backup and restore. Contains ads and in-app purchases; ad removal and unlimited records are premium features.

records.name: Would You Rather : A form that listens
records.tagline: Build forms using voice & receive answers as voice for free
records.description: Would You Rather is a form builder with voice on both ends. Describe the form you need and AI drafts it with the right field types. Record each question in your own voice. Respondents answer by speaking from any phone browser, in any language, no app or login. Branching logic, your brand, collaborators, walk-up QR forms and a public API are built in. Every answer lands live in a Google Sheet you own, audio attached. Free to use today.

records.name: Quechains
records.tagline: Real-time global supply chain visibility & control
records.description: QueChains is a supply chain platform for freight forwarders, 3PLs, manufacturers, and procurement teams in fast-growing markets. Get real-time multi-modal shipment tracking (ocean, air, road), AI-powered disruption alerts, automated customs documentation, and warehouse/inventory management in one dashboard. Unlike legacy tools like SAP TM or Oracle TMS, QueChains is built and priced for growth-market logistics teams: enterprise-grade visibility, without the enterprise price tag.

records.name: Aspect Ratio Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate the other pixel size from a ratio
records.description: Calculate aspect ratio from width and height in pixels. or calculate the missing width or height for any ratio. Aspect Ratio Calculator: Calculate aspect ratios and dimensions. Image Resizer: Resize an image to specific pixel dimensions while preserving its proportions. Image Cropper: Crop an image to a specific ratio, such as 1:1 or 16:9, when you need a particular composition. Video Aspect Ratio Calculator: Work out suitable dimensions for video formats such as 16:9 and 9:16.

records.name: TalentMind
records.tagline: Soft-skill and culture-fit scores from interview recordings
records.description: TalentMind turns interview recordings into reports you can check. Upload a recording and in about 3 minutes get soft-skill scores that open down to the quotes behind them, with a written reason why each score isn't higher or lower, a culture-fit check against your own company's profile, and questions for the next round. No bot joins your calls and recordings aren't stored. Free to start: paste your company's website and read its culture profile in under a minute.

records.name: AI Image Detector
records.tagline: Check AI signals in car, property and everyday photos
records.description: Check photos for signs of AI generation with a free, bilingual tool. Explore general, car and property modes, review multiple listing photos together, and download a visual PDF report. Category checks help keep car and property reviews relevant. Photos are processed without being stored for training. Try one photo without signing in; create a free account for more. Results show model signals and uncertainty—not proof of authenticity or seller trust.

records.name: prt
records.tagline: Inspect ports and owning processes in your terminal
records.description: A free, MIT-licensed Rust TUI for macOS and Linux. Find port conflicts, inspect the owning process and follow process-to-port-to-endpoint topology. Filter live connections or export JSON, CSV and NDJSON. Version 0.6.0 installs with Cargo or Homebrew. Process visibility depends on OS permissions; macOS uses lsof and Linux reads /proc.

records.name: Money Left
records.tagline: Know what’s left after this month’s bills
records.description: Plan what you’ll have left at month-end—not just what you spent. Money Left brings income, paid bills, upcoming payments and living-cost estimates into one iPhone dashboard. Browse past and future months, schedule bills every 1–12 months, and update payments without double counting. Budget records stay on your device; no account or bank connection needed. English/Japanese, with 14 budget currencies (one per budget; no FX conversion). Free with limited app-open ads.

records.description: 🎁 Give Yourself More Entertainment! 🎮🎬 Looking for more ways to enjoy apps, games, movies, music, and digital entertainment? records.name: PolicyProof — AI insurance readiness
records.tagline: Score your agent ops like an AI-liability underwriter
records.description: Insurers brace for multimillion-dollar rogue-agent claims (FT, Oct 6 2026). The question flipped: not "are we compliant?" but "can we get covered, and at what premium?" PolicyProof is the pack a founder/CFO hands an insurance broker: an insurability self-assessment (0-100 score + gap report sorted by premium impact), controls inventory, incident-history log, disclosure-SLA sheet, D&O governance checklist, one-page broker summary — plus a FastAPI evidence API.

records.name: ASL PC Steward
records.tagline: Understand your Windows PC with evidence and guided actions
records.description: Review Windows health, grouped processes, storage, reliability history and available hardware readings in one native workspace. Findings explain the evidence, timing and limits. Ordinary scans stay local and read-only; cleanup and supported cooling actions need separate approval. Requires Windows 11 x64 build 22621 or newer. Available as a one-time Microsoft Store purchase; hardware support varies.

records.name: Rowfire
records.tagline: Turn database events into Slack, Zendesk & Braze actions
records.description: Most tools watch a table for new rows (Zapier, n8n) or sync columns (reverse ETL). Rowfire fires on any SQL query you write: joins, aggregates, even what didn't happen, like "trial ends in 3 days, never activated". records.name: Othello

records.description: Play the ultimate Othello experience! 45+ achievements, online multiplayer, 4 AI levels, multiple soundtracks, and smooth animations. Available now on Android and iOS!

records.name: Thalassa
records.tagline: Dive center software that shows your real profit
records.description: Thalassa is management software for freediving and dive centers. Most dive software is built for fun dives and gear rental; Thalassa is built around multi-session courses, so every student's sessions owed vs done are tracked per booking. Instructor scheduling warns about clashes, every booking shows its deposits and balance, and profit, margin and break-even update automatically from the work the team already records.

records.name: Signava
records.tagline: Crypto signals with entry, stop loss & take profit
records.description: Signava is an Android app that sends crypto trading signals for spot and futures — LONG and SHORT — each with a precise entry, a stop loss and three take-profit levels, so every trade has a plan before you click buy. What's different: • Every signal is reviewed by AI before it's sent • Push alerts when a signal opens and when it hits TP or SL • Live spot & futures charts with signal lines • Free futures, spot, position-size and liquidation calculators on signava.app

records.name: RespKit
records.tagline: Consistent Go API responses, customizable to your stack
records.description: RespKit gives Go APIs consistent JSON responses, stable error codes, and localized messages with zero configuration. Customize errors, translations, mappers, and envelope key naming. Add field validation details or opt into RFC 9457 Problem Details. Works with net/http, Gin, Echo, Fiber, Chi, Gorilla/mux, and Beego. Includes an optional pgx adapter. Raw internal errors stay private by default. The core uses only Go's standard library.

records.name: Emetli
records.tagline: Learn first, play after

records.name: TripLala
records.tagline: One app for the itinerary, packing, souvenirs and the bill

Schedule, packing, wishlist, souvenirs, money and to-dos live in one app, edited by everyone on the trip. • Packing sorted by the bag it goes in • A souvenir list, so you never buy for the same person twice • Prices in local currency, totals in yours • Uneven bill splits, too Free, with optional extras. iOS, Android, 9 languages.

records.name: Can I Ship This Model?

Every finding cites file path, SHA-256 hash, and raw text excerpt. No LLM, no hallucination. Unlike FOSSA or Snyk, built specifically for Hugging Face model licenses.

records.name: ClinicalTrial OS

records.description: Two Android phones become a baby monitor. Put an old phone by the crib, take the other with you. Sound is free and unlimited — listen all night, no ads. Video is free for 5 minutes a day. Premium unlocks unlimited sharper video and talking to the baby. Alerts work with the app closed. Encrypted phone-to-phone. Nothing recorded or stored. No account. First 50: 21-day Premium code F2Z7-QJA7-MPVG Not a medical device.

records.name: DockPinch: PDF & Image Optimizer
records.tagline: Compress PDFs and images offline, right from your Dock
records.description: Drop PDFs and images onto DockPinch in your Mac's Dock to reduce file size. Your files stay on your Mac, with no uploads. Use the Studio window to adjust compression and image formats. Optimize up to 5 single files a day for free. Pro unlocks unlimited, batch, and folder processing for a one-time $14.99 purchase in the US. No subscription. macOS 15+.

records.name: SeamlessCanvas
records.tagline: Generate, repair and preview seamless patterns and textures
records.description: SeamlessCanvas helps designers, POD creators, and game and 3D artists create repeat-ready assets. Generate patterns and textures with AI, or upload an existing image to repair its seams. Check the result in a tiled preview before exporting. Useful for fabric and wallpaper patterns, repeating backgrounds, and tileable textures.

records.name: Campidu
records.tagline: Discover Nigerian businesses, products, and deals
records.description: Campidu brings Nigerian businesses, products, and deals into one place. Explore vendor catalogs, read customer reviews, ask questions, and contact businesses directly. Follow your favorites for new products, offers, and updates in a personalized feed. For vendors, Campidu offers a way to reach customers beyond their social media followers.

records.name: Ballast
records.tagline: A morning reading, then score Focus, Love, Money and Energy
records.description: Ballast gives you one short reading each morning, then asks you to score how the day actually went in four areas: Focus, Love, Money and Energy. After a few weeks the wheel shows which part of your life you are quietly starving. Four spokes, each a 30-day average, with today's score as a ring on it. The area you have ignored longest is drawn faint, so the thin side of your month is the first thing you see. Drawn from your own numbers, and it only moves when they do.

records.name: Academee
records.tagline: AI-powered study tool with FSRS, spaced repetition and more
records.description: Stop drowning in lecture slides. Academee turns 200+ page PDFs into interactive Knowledge Galaxies in 60 seconds. Unlike passive summaries, our AI tutor Mee tests you with Socratic active recall. Powered by next-gen FSRS spaced repetition algorithms, concepts stick directly in your long-term memory. Track progress like a gamified skill tree and conquer exam anxiety. 100% free course project to start.

records.name: Tori
records.tagline: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences
records.description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

records.name: shippedit.me
records.tagline: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights
records.description: Weekly launch battles + a permanent page that keeps working: dofollow backlink, AEO & CRO audits, competitor monitoring, real analytics, and AI fix cards.

records.name: SimpleSpread
records.tagline: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet
records.description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

records.name: HireKey
records.tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
records.description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

records.name: kōdlo
records.tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
records.description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

records.name: DevTerminal
records.tagline: A macOS terminal with a Run button that knows your project
records.description: DevTerminal is a normal macOS terminal (your shell, your config) where every tab knows what project it's in. ⌘R in an Android app installs it on your phone and streams logcat. In an iOS app it launches in the Simulator or on your iPhone. Spring Boot, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, Rust, Go, Django, Rails and more just work. Run output sits under your shell, so Claude Code keeps the tab. $39 once, no subscription.

records.name: Mentally Prepare
records.tagline: A 21-night journal with one anonymous partner
records.description: Mentally Prepare is a 21-night writing ritual for adults 18+. Answer one prompt each night alongside a matched, anonymous partner. Notes unlock the next day. On night 21, both choose whether to reveal their identities; one choice to stay anonymous keeps both private. No feed, likes, or public profiles. Free during early access. This is peer connection, not therapy.

records.name: Pickle Sensei
records.tagline: AI pickleball coach for solo training, one swing at a time
records.description: Pickle Sensei is an AI pickleball coach for solo training on iPhone. Step into the start zone alone, swing one stroke, and get an estimated player rating, a technique score, checkpoint scores, and the one thing to fix next. Covers serves, returns, drives, dinks, third-shot drops, volleys and overheads. Slow-motion form review with a skeleton overlay, 40+ drills, progress tracking and ranks. Video stays on your device. Free to try, one rating included, then Pro from $7.99 a month.

records.name: Ayven
records.tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
records.description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

records.name: Scribbble
records.tagline: Draw over anything on your Mac screen with one hotkey
records.description: Scribbble lets you draw on top of any app on your Mac. Press a hotkey, sketch, press it again to clear. No windows, no setup, no subscription. Pen, arrows, rectangles, highlighter, spotlight, magnifier, measure, text, whiteboard and auto-fading strokes, each one keystroke away. Works across multiple monitors. Built for live demos, teaching, streaming and screen recordings. Free to try, one-time $12 license with lifetime updates.

records.name: Dotwoven
records.tagline: Generate Custom QRCodes based on your logo
records.description: Turn your logo into a personalised QR code. Preview your design, then unlock scan-checked PNG and SVG downloads that link directly to your website.

records.name: NewMinecraftServers
records.tagline: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection.
records.description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.

records.name: SwarmPane
records.tagline: One desktop workspace for all your AI coding agents
records.description: SwarmPane is a desktop workspace for the coding agents you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok, Cursor and more, each in a real terminal, up to 16 side by side. See which one needs you, race two on the same task and let your tests pick the winner, undo any agent step, and keep going when a usage limit hits. Use several Claude Code or Codex accounts, chain agents into workflows, and talk to them with Voice on Mac. For Mac, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Sira Monitoring
records.tagline: Sira Monitoring (Server & AI API Cost Tracker)
records.description: Sira Monitoring (Server & AI API Cost Tracker): A real-time observability platform that tracks server uptime and AI API expenses to prevent unexpected downtime and financial losses.

records.name: Pokko: Expense & Budget App
records.tagline: Know your safe-to-spend amount, every day
records.description: Pokko helps you answer two questions: “How much can I spend?” and “How much should I spend?” Budget around your actual payday, track expenses, account for upcoming bills, and see your safe-to-spend amount. No account required—your financial data stays on your device. We're building Pokko from real-life needs and would love your feedback to make it better.

records.name: AppLocker
records.tagline: Android app lock: lend your phone, keep your apps shut
records.description: Someone borrows your phone to make a call or look at a photo. AppLocker keeps everything else shut: your chats, gallery and banking ask for your PIN or pattern. It doesn't use Accessibility, the permission that can read your whole screen and that most app lockers ask for. No account, and your PIN never leaves the phone. If someone guesses wrong, Pro quietly takes their photo and shows the code they tried. Kids Mode leaves only the apps you allow. Free for 3 apps (with ads).

records.name: OpenScreen 2
records.tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
records.description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

records.name: MePersona
records.tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
records.description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

records.name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
records.tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
records.description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.

records.name: Find Right Plugin
records.tagline: Find Right WordPress Plugin in 60 Seconds
records.description: Free WordPress plugin recommender. Answer 3 questions and get a personalized shortlist matched to your problem and your role. No sign-up is required to use either quiz. Recommendations are based on a weighted rubric (ratings, active installs, update recency, WP version compatibility, support, and more) rather than which vendor pays the highest commission — free tools are recommended over paid ones wherever they're honestly the better fit, and this is stated plainly on results pages.

records.name: CatAccent
records.tagline: Practica l'ortografia catalana escrivint paraules i frases.
records.description: Una eina gratuïta i interactiva per dominar l'ortografia catalana escrivint de veritat. A diferència d'altres tests tipus test (multiopció) on és fàcil encertar per atzar, CatAccent et obliga a escriure la paraula o frase completa, fixant la memòria visual i muscular de l'accentuació, diacrítics o combinacions com B/V i G/J. Then Animate your Designs with no time limits (Up to 30 Sec per Scene generation) with MNKI Video built-in Timeline Editor — free to start - 40 Free Credits on Sign up. No Credit Card needed.

Drag, resize and swipe them into your own layout. Try it free for 14 days, then buy once and keep it for life.

Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in the same window. Built on libghostty, so it reads your Ghostty config. Free and MIT licensed. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: Kooler
records.tagline: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar
records.description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

records.name: Agibot
records.tagline: The always-on personal AI agent for your Mac. $0 forever
records.description: Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

records.name: Unboom
records.tagline: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels
records.description: Unboom finds the bass note your untreated room exaggerates and gently turns just that down on your Mac. Scan with your mic or pick it by ear, choose Gentle, Medium, or Strong, and flip Correction on. Never boosts. No data collected. No subscription.

records.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
records.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
records.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

records.name: editPSD.net
records.tagline: edit,psd,photoshop file,online,editor,graphic design
records.description: Open and edit PSD files right in your browser. Get started in seconds — no Photoshop installation or account required. EditPSD.net is a free online Photoshop alternative that brings a familiar Adobe Photoshop-style interface directly to your web browser. Open and edit PSD files online with a professional editing workspace designed to look and feel like Photoshop, without downloading or installing desktop software.

records.name: FLUX.2 Styles
records.tagline: 93 art styles compared on the same scenes with FLUX.2
records.description: 93 art styles, from watercolor to voxel art, rendered with FLUX.2 [klein] on the same six scenes and one seed: 564 images side by side, to see what "ukiyo-e" or "low poly" really does to afox, a lighthouse or a city square. Each style comes with the exact sentence that produced it, one click to copy. About half of the style names are ignored by the model when used as a word;describing the technique works, and those sentences are the result. Free, no account.

records.description: Ladivis — це не додаток із нагадуваннями. Це система повного контролю над ліками. Free, no account.

Upload audio and separate vocals, drums, bass and other stems, or choose a six-stem split with guitar and piano. Preview stems with solo and mute, then download individual files or a ZIP. No Python or local GPU setup. Includes 15 free credits each month and paid options. Not affiliated with Meta or the Demucs authors.

records.name: SHOPLOCK Login Required
records.tagline: Password Protection, Shopify
records.description: SHOPLOCK Login Required helps Shopify merchants control store access with login requirements and passcode protection for products, collections, pages, and URLs. Use customer-tag restrictions, customizable passcode pages, automatic passcodes, and page exclusions to create private shopping experiences for B2B, wholesale, and members-only stores.

records.name: Escrit
records.tagline: Research, create, SEO-optimise, publish content that sells.

Discover trending topics, research credible sources, generate fact-checked content, optimise for SEO and AI search visibility, and prepare content for publishing. With built-in newsletters, content repurposing, editorial calendars and performance insights, Escrit helps creators, brands and teams produce high-quality content faster, attract organic traffic and turn readers into customers.

records.name: SolSecureAI

Unlike traditional testing tools, SolSecureAI combines crowdsourced AI red teaming, interactive challenges, and transparent blockchain reward management. Currently live on Solana Devnet.

records.name: MySetMatch

records.description: MySetMatch brings players and tournament organizers together on web, iPhone, and Android. Organizers can manage competitions with automated brackets and scoring—all in one platform.

records.description: Voice, text chat and screen sharing for a few friends on Windows. One friend hosts on their own PC, the others join with an invite code, and packets go straight to the host's PC, encrypted. No accounts, no cloud. Free and open source, built for low delay.

records.name: UnfollowMonkey
records.tagline: Get a DM when someone unfollows you on X
records.description: UnfollowMonkey watches your X followers and sends you a DM when someone unfollows you, with their name and how long they'd followed you. The dashboard keeps every alert, a follower history chart, and who doesn't follow you back. Sign in with X, no password, and it never posts as you. Free for accounts under 2,000 followers; paid plans check daily or every 5 minutes.

records.name: CELESTIAL Calendar

CELESTIAL Calendar is a Windows app for exploring astronomy and selected religious and cultural calendars, keeping a journal, and building a personal Daily Ritual canvas. Customize your space with themes, save your entries locally, and export backups. Made for curious minds and thoughtful daily routines.

Choose models with live rankings and speed and pricing comparisons, run up to four chats side by side, and track generation costs as you go.

records.name: Kubflow AI

records.description: Startups juggle a docs tool, a chat app, a CRM, an ATS and spreadsheets. What's different: • HEYAI, a built-in agent that knows your company and flags what's slipping • Investor workspaces for angels, syndicates and VCs to follow portfolio progress, so founders skip the PDF update Every plan includes every module.

records.description: Explore Helax AI, a Sri Lankan AI technology project featuring Helax N3, generative AI, intelligent tools and creative AI experiences.

records.name: Comet
records.tagline: agent skill harness for turn ideas into evaluated workflows
records.description: Comet: Agent Skill Harness for Turning Ideas into Evaluated Workflows.

records.name: Liniqo
records.tagline: Hairline isometric illustrations as SVG, PNG and animated
records.description: Liniqo: hairline isometric illustrations as SVG, PNG and animated files. 300 free pieces to download.

records.name: Rudra Water Proofing Systems
records.tagline: Epoxy Floor Coating Services in India
records.description: Explore Rudra WPS for expert waterproofing & protective coating solutions. High-quality services for durable surfaces. Contact us for a consultation!

records.name: AOM Roomi
records.tagline: Nền tảng quản lý lưu trú toàn diện
records.description: Nền tảng miễn phí cho chủ khách sạn, nhà nghỉ, nhà trọ, chung cư mini (CCMN), căn hộ dịch vụ, homestay: quản lý phòng và hợp đồng, hóa đơn tự tính, tiền chuyển khoản tự gạch nợ, phòng trống tự lên website mang tên miền của bạn.

records.name: Tetherly
records.tagline: Your Mac, right there on your phone
records.description: Tetherly lets you view and control your Mac from your phone over Wi-Fi or Tailscale. Click, type, and share files without a Tetherly account. Free and open source. Mac and Android downloads are available now; iPhone and iPad App Store availability is coming soon.

records.name: Hybrid Bot
records.tagline: One bot that gets the building done.
records.description: Meet Hybrid. One bot that reads your code, hands changes to a developer in the background, and tells you honestly what it did. Open source.

records.name: ClearFiledTax
records.tagline: Free calculators for no tax on tips & overtime, IRS-sourced
records.description: ClearFiledTax shows US workers what the new federal tips and overtime deductions (2025–2028) are actually worth. Free calculators apply the $25,000 tips cap, the $12,500/$25,000 overtime-premium cap and the MAGI phase-out; a refund estimator compares tax with and without the deduction. No signup, inputs stay in your browser, and every figure is sourced to 26 USC 224/225, Schedule 1-A and IRS notices.

records.name: NicheSEO Pro
records.tagline: Check Domain authority
records.description: Check any website's Domain Authority (DA) on a 1–100 scale, run a technical SEO site health audit scored out of 100, and audit a store's product catalog.

records.name: Shop Inventory & Sales Manager
records.tagline: Bilingual Excel inventory & invoicing for small shops
records.description: Bilingual (EN + AR, RTL) Excel toolkit for small shops: product catalog with SKU, cost/price and auto margin %; stock-in and sales logs with auto cost lookup; expense log; live inventory with stock value and OK / LOW–Reorder / OUT OF STOCK alerts; dashboard with revenue, COGS, profit, expenses, units and charts; invoice generator with tax and print. Sample data included. No macros or add-ins; works in Microsoft Excel (desktop & web). One-time $24, commercial license, instant download.

records.name: ArahaSoft Private Limited
records.tagline: Creating Values Through Intelligence
records.description: ArahaSoft provides enterprise audit and compliance management software that simplifies audit workflows, improves compliance management, and enables certification bodies to manage operations efficiently.

records.name: Skate 3 Browser
records.tagline: Skate 3 Browser — Play Online, No Download
records.description: Skate 3 Browser is a fan-made browser-based skateboarding project that lets players explore Port Carverton, perform tricks, and skate using a keyboard or game controller without installing a traditional desktop game.

records.name: Rijhwaani Associates
records.tagline: AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor
records.description: Rijhwaani Associates is an AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor offering expert mutual fund investment solutions, SIP, and personalized financial knowledge.

records.name: Wedvitation
records.tagline: Wedding invitations that open like a film
records.description: Wedvitation turns a wedding invitation into one link your guests tap to watch it open (an envelope, palace doors or a velvet curtain) with music, then RSVP right inside it. Venue map, add-to-calendar and a countdown are built in. One payment ($30 or $50) covers unlimited guests, where most e-invite services charge per guest. 12 languages, including Arabic right to left, and the invitation never expires. Free to build; pay only when you publish.

records.name: relayted shots
records.tagline: Pay per Use Browsershots
records.description: Easy Breezy Browser screenshots of your website in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. Payment via Lightning, starting from 0,50 Euro.

records.name: MindCart -Shopping List
records.tagline: Your everyday shopping list, made simple
records.description: MindCart is a simple shopping list app that helps you organize everyday shopping and never forget what to buy. 🛒 Create multiple lists, add items with quantities, units, prices, categories, and notes. Track purchased and pending items, search quickly, and reuse previous lists for weekly or monthly shopping. MindCart works offline, keeping your shopping essentials organized wherever you go. Built independently to make everyday shopping easier. Try MindCart and share your feedback!

records.name: ClickTheTools
records.tagline: 268+ Free Online AI, PDF, Media & Developer Web Tools
records.description: Supercharge your workflow with 268+ free online tools and AI utilities. Convert PDFs, edit images, track flights, format code, and optimize SEO with zero limits.

records.name: ScentHub.pk
records.tagline: Pakistan's Trusted Perfume  Marketplace
records.description: 💰 Website + Complete Code Available for Sale - DM for price Scenthukpkis Pakistan's first complete multi-vendor marketplace for Perfume Built with Supabase. Separate Buyer & Seller panels, auto 15% commission, JazzCash & COD support, 15-day returns. Sellers list products, admin approves, buyers order with fast delivery. 100% production-ready code, responsive, secure auth, real-time orders. Live demo: scenthubpk.netlify.app

records.name: Redact Shot
records.tagline: Redact screenshots and PDFs locally on your Mac
records.description: Redact screenshots, photos, and PDFs before sharing. Drag to add blackout, mosaic, or blur masks. Find possible redactions for emails, IPv4 addresses, or custom text, then review and apply them yourself. Blackout is recommended for sensitive data; blur and mosaic may be reversible. Processing stays on your Mac. PDF export rasterizes every page. Free, with optional tips only. Requires macOS 14+.

records.name: Amazon gift card
records.tagline: 100$ Free gift card
records.description: Gift Card Learn how to buy, redeem, and use gift cards online. This guide covers the basic process of purchasing gift cards, redeeming gift card codes, checking balances, and using gift cards for online payments and shopping. Free gift card link : https://shorturl.at/9Xl6p

records.name: Halo
records.tagline: Notifications, dictation and AI agents in your Mac's notch
records.description: Halo turns your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island: messages from any app, dictation that types anywhere when you hold Fn, a little face that follows your cursor and watches your AI agents, plus music, calls and monitor brightness. $9.99 once.

records.name: EdgeVolume
records.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume from your trackpad edge
records.description: Slide one finger along your Mac’s trackpad edge to adjust the volume. Choose the left edge, right edge, or both, and tune the sensitivity to your preference. EdgeVolume is a free, open-source macOS utility that runs in your menu bar. Currently in early access.

records.name: TripleCheck
records.tagline: Email, phone & IP validation in one single API
records.description: TripleCheck is a 3-in-1 validation API for developers. Validate email addresses, phone numbers, and IP addresses through one simple API. Credits that never expire.

records.name: creativehit
records.tagline: From Ideas to Ads, Faster.
records.description: CreativeHit AI 是面向广告营销团队、内容创作者和电商商家的 AI 广告创意生成工具，支持生成广告创意图、产品视觉和社媒营销素材。

records.name: SnapGen AI
records.tagline: SnapGen AI Video Generator
records.description: Create short videos with SnapGen AI using text prompts or images. Explore Veo models, choose your settings, preview results, and download your next scene.

records.name: Productivity Calculator
records.tagline: Measure your workday and plan when to clock out
records.description: A free browser toolkit for understanding your workday. Measure productive time, daily score, time lost, and focus signals, or calculate when to clock out from your start time, billable hours, target rate, and unpaid breaks. Includes focused tools for team productivity, utilization, and billable time. No signup required.

records.name: Poketrade.ai - Got Doubles? Let’s Trade.
records.tagline: Trade Pokémon cards with collectors near you
records.description: Buy, sell, or swap card-for-card with people in your area — and settle the deal in person. Scan a card to list it in seconds, with real-time market prices built in. For high-value deals, trade verified through official partner stores.

records.name: United Auto Film
records.tagline: Less Heat. More Comfort. Ultra Ceramic.
records.description: United Auto Film’s Ultra Nano Ceramic is the perfect entry into professional-grade ceramic window tint. Designed for everyday installers who want trusted ceramic performance at a more accessible price point, this 2-Ply, 2 mil film offers high infrared heat rejection, a clean OEM-style appearance, and easy workability.

records.name: LinkedIn BS Remover
records.tagline: LinkedIn humblebrags, translated to greentext. Free.
records.description: Free Chrome extension that turns LinkedIn humblebrags into greentext as you scroll. 500 words of "I'm humbled to announce" become four lines. Hit Show Original when a post is actually worth reading. No API key needed.

records.name: Rumpelstiltskin AI by LipSyncTool
records.tagline: Cast two portraits in a fairy-tale dance video
records.description: Rumpelstiltskin AI by LipSyncTool lets you personalize a fixed 6-second dance video template with two portraits. Choose who dances and who watches, swap roles, and preview the template with sound before generating. The template is 720p in landscape 16:9 format, with its matching soundtrack included. Generation requires an account and costs 90 credits. Review the generated result and download the MP4. This is an early version: facial likeness, hair and clothing details may vary.

records.name: Track calories smarter with AI-powered
records.tagline: Snap your food. Track your nutrition. Reach your goals.
records.description: Meet Calbit, your AI-powered nutrition and fitness companion, built to help you understand your food, build healthier habits, and work toward your wellness goals. Calbit brings nutrition tracking, personalized diet planning, activity monitoring, and AI assistance together in one simple app.

records.name: AskYourStack
records.tagline: Let your AI run your server and SEO, safely
records.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to your Linux server, Google Search Console, GA4, Bing and Cloudflare over MCP. Your AI sets up the server, installs Magento or WordPress, reads logs, fixes errors and audits your SEO. Risky actions wait for your approval, and snapshots let you roll back.

records.name: Unterschrift Erstellen
records.tagline: Unterschrift online erstellen – Unterschrift-Generator
records.description: Handschriftliche Unterschrift erstellen mit unserem Unterschrift Generator. Erstellen Sie Ihre digitale Signatur schnell und einfach online.

records.name: Engine Nexus
records.tagline: Find the right used or remanufactured engine—fast.
records.description: Browse our inventory of used and remanufactured engines. Select your make to find the right replacement engine with fast shipping across the U.S.
